documentation.description: Returns the contents of a Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse, organized by workspace and lakehouse.
documentation.longDescription: Fabric-specific M extension. Returns a navigation table whose root is workspaces. Drill into a workspace to see lakehouses, and into a lakehouse to see Tables and Files.

functionParameters.name: optionalParameters
functionParameters.description: Optional record of parameters. Supports HierarchicalNavigation (logical).

documentation.description: Returns the contents of a Microsoft Fabric Warehouse, organized by workspace and warehouse.
documentation.longDescription: Fabric-specific M extension. Returns a navigation table for browsing Warehouses across workspaces and selecting tables/views.

functionParameters.name: optionalParameters
functionParameters.description: Optional record of parameters. Supports HierarchicalNavigation (logical).

documentation.description: Returns a navigation table of Power Platform Dataflows the caller can access.
documentation.longDescription: Used to consume the output of one dataflow from another. The returned navigation table is keyed by environment, workspace, dataflow, and entity.

documentation.description: Returns a navigation table of Power BI Dataflows the caller can access.
